mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains below its prior four-week average while TRANSIT also stays depressed, weekday city-center shopping demand stays weak and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks. The mechanism acts through reduced commuting-linked errands rather than leisure substitution.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain at or below their current levels for the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp weekly increase in PARKS relative to the prior week shifts leisure time toward outdoor venues and away from indoor retail and dining, lowering RETAIL_REC within one week. This should appear as a short lagged tradeoff when park mobility jumps.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 20 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from -7.0 to 30.7 between t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next week after a PARKS jump of 20 points or more, or instead increases.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays positive while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, households are likely consolidating short neighborhood trips and spending less on discretionary retail. That combination should depress RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is flat or higher over the next 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above zero and RESIDENTIAL staying above its last-4-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains more than 25 points below baseline for another month, access friction and reduced city-center circulation will keep discretionary retail below the previous month. The effect is a persistent negative drag on RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -25 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT stays below -25 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM accompanied by weaker WORKPLACES indicates more local errand substitution and fewer discretionary shopping trips. Under that mix, RETAIL_REC should decline over the next four weeks rather than recover.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains above zero and WORKPLACES remains below its recent average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS combined with elevated RESIDENTIAL captures warm-weather stay-local behavior that substitutes for shopping trips. In that seasonal regime, RETAIL_REC should be lower within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 14 days while PARKS stays above its last-4-week mean and RESIDENTIAL stays elevated.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES recovers above its recent average while TRANSIT remains suppressed, the commuting network is still constrained and shoppers do not fully return to central retail districts. RETAIL_REC will stay below the last four-week level over the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above its prior 4-week mean while TRANSIT remains below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES moving above its recent mean and TRANSIT staying below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week improvement in GROCERY_PHARM followed by persistent weakness in TRANSIT signals households are meeting needs close to home while avoiding longer discretionary trips. That pattern should reduce RETAIL_REC within the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns positive after being negative in the prior week and TRANSIT remains below -25
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is around -26 to -30 across the last four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline within one week after GROCERY_PHARM improves and TRANSIT remains below -25.
